reviewItem.question: For "Helm: New value `webhook.extraEnv` allows you to set custom environment variables in the webhook Pod", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a new Helm value `webhook.extraEnv` that allows setting custom environment variables in the webhook Pod (the same release note / PR #7317 also adds the analogous values `cainjector.extraEnv` and `startupapicheck.extraEnv`, which are separate subjects of the same addition).
